seo.title: Frequently Asked Questions about Software Development
seo.description: We answer the most common questions about software development, web and mobile applications, pricing, timelines, and technologies in Latin America.
seo.keywords: frequently asked questions software development, how much does an app cost, how long does web development take, best software development company Latin America, hire remote developers, website price Colombia

faq.hero_subtitle: We answer the most common questions about software development, pricing, timelines, and technologies. If you don't find what you're looking for, contact us directly.
faq.cta_desc: Message us on WhatsApp and we'll respond instantly.

items.q1_a: Custom software development is the creation of applications specifically designed for your business's unique needs. Unlike generic software, a custom solution adapts to your processes, scales with your growth, and gives you a competitive advantage. At Molink, every project begins with a deep analysis of your objectives to deliver a solution that truly transforms your operation.
items.q2_q: What's the difference between a website and a web application?
items.q2_a: A website is primarily informational: it displays content like text, images, and contact forms. A web application is interactive and functional: it allows users to perform actions like managing inventories, processing payments, administering users, or generating reports. If your business needs functionality beyond displaying information, you need a web application. Both types of development require different approaches and budgets.
items.q3_q: Do you develop apps for iOS and Android?
items.q3_a: Yes. We develop both native and cross-platform mobile applications. For most projects, we use technologies like React Native or Flutter that allow creating a single codebase that works on iOS and Android, reducing costs and development times without sacrificing quality. We evaluate your particular case to recommend the best technical and economic option.
items.q4_q: What's included in a complete web development project?
items.q4_a: A complete project includes: requirements analysis, UI/UX design, frontend and backend development, functionality testing, performance optimization, hosting and domain configuration, SSL certificate implementation, basic SEO, training for using the admin panel, and post-launch technical support. We deliver a ready-to-operate product, not just code.
items.q5_q: Do you work with clients outside Colombia?
items.q5_a: Absolutely. We work with clients throughout Latin America, the United States, and Europe. Our remote work model allows us to collaborate with companies in Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Spain, and many more countries. We use tools like WhatsApp, video calls, and project management platforms to maintain fluid communication regardless of time zones.

items.q1_q: How much does it cost to develop an application in Latin America?
items.q1_a: Cost varies based on complexity. A landing page can cost from $300 USD, an intermediate web application between $1,500 and $5,000 USD, and a complete mobile application between $3,000 and $10,000+ USD. At Molink, we offer monthly subscription plans starting at $49 USD/month that include hosting, domain, and ongoing support. Each project is unique, so contact us for a personalized budget with no obligation.
items.q2_q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.q2_a: We accept payments in multiple currencies: COP (Colombian pesos), USD (dollars), EUR (euros), PEN (soles), MXN (Mexican pesos), ARS (Argentine pesos), and CLP (Chilean pesos). Payment methods include bank transfer, Nequi, Daviplata, PayPal, and card payments through secure gateways. We offer payment facilities for large projects.
items.q3_q: Is it cheaper to hire a freelancer than an agency?
items.q3_a: A freelancer may have lower rates, but an agency like Molink offers a complete team (designer, developer, tester), established processes, delivery guarantee, ongoing support, and business backing. For critical business projects, the quality-price ratio of an agency is usually superior in the long run. We offer competitive prices that combine the best of both worlds.
items.q4_q: How much does website maintenance cost?
items.q4_a: With our subscription plans, maintenance is included: security updates, backups, performance monitoring, fixes, and technical support. Independently, monthly maintenance can cost between $50 and $200 USD depending on site complexity. Our annual plans offer the best value with savings of up to 20%.
items.q5_q: Does the price include responsive mobile design?
items.q5_a: Yes. All our projects include responsive design by default. Your site or application will look and function correctly on smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers. Today, over 60% of web traffic comes from mobile devices, so a mobile-first design isn't optional—it's essential.

items.q1_q: How long does web application development take?
items.q1_a: It depends on complexity. A landing page can be ready in 1-2 weeks. An intermediate web application takes 4-8 weeks. More complex projects with advanced integrations can take 3-6 months. At each phase, we keep you informed of progress with partial deliveries so you can see the real progress of your project.
items.q2_q: What do I need to start a development project?
items.q2_a: Ideally, you need: a clear idea of what you want to achieve, information about your business (logo, corporate colors, content), and availability for planning meetings. You don't need technical knowledge; we guide you through every step. If you don't have everything defined, no problem: we start with an analysis and consulting phase to structure your idea.
items.q3_q: What's the development process step by step?
items.q3_a: Our process has 4 phases: (1) Analysis and consultation: we understand your needs and define scope. (2) Design and prototype: we create wireframes and interactive designs for your approval. (3) Development: we code with sprints and show you periodic progress. (4) Launch and support: we deploy your project and provide ongoing support. The entire process is transparent and collaborative.
items.q4_q: Can I see progress during development?
items.q4_a: Of course. We work with agile methodologies that include incremental deliveries. Every 1-2 weeks, we show you completed features so you can provide feedback and adjust direction if needed. We don't wait until the end for you to see results; the entire process is transparent.
items.q5_q: What if I'm not satisfied with the result?
items.q5_a: Our process includes reviews at each phase to ensure the result matches your expectations. If there are aspects that don't meet what was agreed, we correct them at no additional cost. We have a warranty policy that covers bug fixes and minor adjustments after delivery. Your satisfaction is our priority.

items.q1_q: What technologies do you use for development?
items.q1_a: We use modern, robust technologies: React and Next.js for frontend, Node.js and Express for backend, MongoDB and MySQL for databases, React Native for mobile applications, and Tailwind CSS for responsive designs. We choose the most suitable technology based on each project's needs, prioritizing performance, scalability, and maintainability.
items.q2_a: The domain is your website's address (e.g., molink.com.co)—it's your 'address' on the internet. Hosting (web hosting) is the 'land' where your site's files are stored so they're accessible 24/7. Both are essential for having an online presence. Our subscription plans include hosting and domain for the duration of the contract.
items.q3_a: Yes. We implement essential security measures: SSL certificate (the green padlock in the browser), protection against common attacks (XSS, SQL injection), data validation, and periodic backups. Additionally, our maintenance plans include continuous security updates to protect your site against new vulnerabilities.
items.q4_a: Responsive design means your website automatically adapts to the screen size of the device you use: computer, tablet, or smartphone. It's not simply 'making it smaller,' but reorganizing elements so the experience is optimal on any device. Over 60% of web traffic comes from mobile, so it's fundamental.
items.q5_q: Can I manage my website myself?
items.q5_a: Yes, in most projects we include an intuitive admin panel where you can manage content, products, users, orders, and more without needing technical knowledge. Additionally, we provide training so you learn to use all features. If you need help, our support is available.

items.q1_q: Do you offer a warranty on the work done?
items.q1_a: Yes. All our projects include a warranty period where we fix any bugs or functional errors for free, as long as they weren't caused by subsequent modifications by the client. Our commitment is that your project works perfectly from day one and stays that way.
items.q2_a: Post-launch support includes: bug fixes, consultations about system usage, minor functional modifications, performance and availability monitoring, and security updates. With our subscription plans, support is ongoing and priority, with response times of less than 24 hours.
items.q3_q: Can I request changes after delivery?
items.q3_a: Of course. Projects evolve and it's normal to want to add features or make adjustments. If changes are within the original scope, the warranty covers them. For new features, we give you a quick quote and implement them in the next iteration. Your project can grow with you.
items.q4_q: How do I contact you if I have a problem?
items.q4_a: You can contact us via WhatsApp (+57 315 575 6600) for quick answers, by email (contacto@molink.com.co) for formal inquiries, or directly from your project's admin panel if you have an active plan. We respond within 24 business hours.
items.q5_a: Yes. If you already have a website but needs a visual refresh, performance improvements, or technology updates, we can redesign it without losing your Google ranking or existing content. We do a complete audit and propose a progressive improvement plan.

gallinas-en-casa.title: Gallinas en casa
gallinas-en-casa.shortDescription: Project developed during my SENA training stage; it is a mobile app developed in Flutter for Android. It helps small farmers in the Norte de Santander region keep track of egg collection, find useful tips, and access a community support forum.
gallinas-en-casa.objective: Create an easy-access application through mobile devices for greater reach and benefit for the target community.
fullDescription: The Gallinas en casa project was born from a challenge that all SENA apprentices must complete, where we must present a project that benefits the community in a real environment.

I started with the requirements analysis based on the current problems in the poultry sector, where SENA sought to support families and small farmers to optimize breeding, care, and egg collection processes, this being the livelihood of many families in my region, Norte de Santander.
Upon entering the project, the system will ask for registration or login, which can be done through a form managed by Firebase Authenticator or Google as a second option.

The application shows a simple navigation panel, allowing management of the personal profile, a guide book, a tool that recommends the number of chickens that should be per square meter, and a space for support forums among the community using the application.

proyecto-productivas.title: Proyecto Productivas
proyecto-productivas.shortDescription: We developed a web application based on PHP and JS as a team to monitor SENA apprentices in their productive stages. This platform unites directors, instructors, and apprentices, providing traceability for logs, data control, and progress reports.
proyecto-productivas.objective: Develop an application where multiple profiles such as directors, instructors, and apprentices could be managed, unifying information and improving processes in productive stages.
fullDescription: This project was developed under an MVC (Model-View-Controller) model. From an initial version, the database was structured to manage multiple aspects of the platform, including: users, apprentices, learning records, monitoring of school and productive stages, process traceability, and role assignment.
The architecture was based on three main profiles:
Directors, with full control to view, create, edit, and delete information across the entire platform.
Instructors, with permissions to manage their apprentices and supervise logbooks.
Apprentices, with the ability to upload their logbooks, make corrections, keep their data updated, and access all necessary formats for their productive stage.

encontrable.title: Encontrable
encontrable.shortDescription: We contributed to the development of a search platform for places of interest, collecting public information and guiding users based on their location. It also serves as a multi-solution tool for businesses.
encontrable.objective: We contributed to the development of a platform that was born as a tool to plan trips to tourist sites, giving the user a more precise guide to places of interest.
fullDescription: My first contributions to this project were the translation of texts in different points of the application, quickly we moved on to start providing structure to the project such as managing places by countries, categories of interest, up to feeding sites in known points.

Quickly the system evolved and users who were registered and wanted to manage their businesses needed an administrative space, in PHP we took care of contributing to create the Full Rest API that would be consumed by React.

The main idea was for businesses to integrate a tool into their businesses that, in addition to positioning them better on the web, could, for example, for restaurants and cafes have a more complete digital menu, and many other tools that adapted to different types of businesses.

power-teams.title: Power Teams
power-teams.shortDescription: We contributed to the development of an application offering virtual fitness classes with various levels and plans that can be purchased directly through the mobile app.
power-teams.objective: We contributed to the development of an administration platform for the business and a mobile application for the end user.
fullDescription: In this project we were in charge of building, based on an initial structure, all the backend part that is managed by expressJS using MongoDB as a database because a large amount of data grouped in arrays would be used, it was the most optimal alternative for the project.
The frontend of the administrative part was built in React based mainly on the Mui Material library, as it offers very dynamic components and modern styles for the platform.
In the mobile application, access to the platform was built collecting data with Firebase Authenticator and storing personal data in Mongo to use them in different points of the application.

advise-services.title: Advise Services
advise-services.shortDescription: We contributed to the development of a web application designed to manage and oversee the company's entire administrative area.
advise-services.objective: We contributed to the development of an administration platform to carry out the internal control of the company.
fullDescription: The project was required to improve the current process system that the company managed, a more modern solution was required and the project began to take shape.
For the backend it was managed with ExpressJS and Mysql as a database.
The frontend was built in React with Typescript which perfectly adapted to the needs of the business.

distribuciones-liderplast.title: Distribuciones Liderplast
distribuciones-liderplast.shortDescription: We developed a complete E-commerce platform from scratch for a plastic distribution company. Users can check prices, manage their cart, and search for products, while administrators have full control over the store.
distribuciones-liderplast.objective: This was our first project focused on an E-commerce for the commercialization of biodegradable plastics, with which we seek to reach more people in Colombia.
fullDescription: In this project we started from the Requirements Analysis, where we analyzed first-hand how the trade worked physically, in such a way that we could address the real needs of the trade to bring the store to presence on the web.
For the FrontEnd the project was structured in React - Typescript and Vite to harness all the versatility and solidity offered by these work environments.

The BackEnd was made entirely in Pure Typescript focused on a Serverless environment such as cloudflare workers, which will allow the E-commerce to manage large volumes of users without having its own servers.
The database was implemented as Cloudflare D1 SQL, which is a MySQLite database prepared to manage multiple purchases in a row without the user perceiving any considerable wait.
It has exclusive storage for images, which allows us to keep the project clean and with better file management.
In the administrative part you can manage: Users, categories, attributes, products with variants, suppliers, inventory, payment methods, orders, shipping management, and administrator profile.

congelados.title: Congelados
congelados.shortDescription: An in-house web application for managing ice cream and fruit shops. It provides everything from employee management to recipe creation based on ingredients, including a free version.
congelados.objective: The purpose of this project is to give control and solutions to businesses dedicated to selling desserts, ice cream, or derivatives.
fullDescription: This project is focused entirely on DevOps; for the FrontEnd we use a React - TypeScript and Vite base, being our preferred stack and where we manage processes best.
For the BackEnd it is 100% managed by Firebase, we use tools like Authenticator, Firestore Database for the management and control of data.
The application was made hand in hand with an ice cream shop that was looking for greater control in its processes.
It features a very complete dashboard giving a visualization of what interests the business most: best day of the month, star products, highest performance day, income vs expenses.

You can manage sales in individual registers, have multiple ice cream shops linked to the same administrator, manage employees, granular permissions for different sections of the platform, create recipes from ingredients, estimated costs for each recipe, management of expenses and purchases, configuration of payment methods, reports of sales, expenses, sessions, and profits.

siempre-modo-leon.title: Siempre Modo León
siempre-modo-leon.shortDescription: A custom WordPress theme where all design and functionalities were tailor-made to meet specific client needs beyond standard plugins.
siempre-modo-leon.objective: The goal of this project was to offer a personalized page that popular WordPress plugins do not achieve.
fullDescription: The page was designed based on the structure that WordPress demands for its correct functioning.
A function was added to the WordPress panel that is responsible for generating dynamic URLs based on a referral code.
TailwindCSS is the basis of the design with some CSS classes.

toche-on.title: Toche On
toche-on.shortDescription: A PWA web application born at Talento Tech that uses artificial intelligence to help users find healthy food establishments near their location.
toche-on.objective: The objective of this project is that through the user's coordinates, artificial intelligence will search for the nearest healthy food places.
fullDescription: The system was designed to be based on React + Typescript and Vite.
The system handles authentication by WhatsApp, Google, and Email.
Data persistence is managed with Firestore Database, Worker for calls to the AI API, and Cloudinary for managing images.

what_are.title: 1. WHAT ARE COOKIES?
what_are.content: A cookie is a small text file that a website stores on your computer or mobile device when you visit the site. This allows the website to remember your actions and preferences (such as login, language, font size, and other display preferences) over a period of time, so you don't have to re-enter them every time you return to the site or navigate from one page to another.

functionality.label: Functionality Cookies:

analytics.label: Performance or Analytics Cookies:

marketing.label: Advertising or Marketing Cookies:
marketing.desc: They may be used by us or third parties (such as social networks or advertising partners) to show you ads that are relevant to you. These cookies may track your navigation across different websites.
